# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in Payara Server or Payara Micro, please email security@payara.fish rather than creating a public issue, discussion or pull request on GitHub. We will then work with you to fix the security issue.

Please include enough detail for us to reproduce the problem: the affected Payara version and edition, your Java version and operating system, and the steps to trigger it.
